# Mixed AutoFit protection and merged minimum pressure

48 original controls generated by `tools/mixed_width_protection_fixture.py`
from the original mixed-rounding-flexible fixture. Each pair preserves preferred
widths while changing whether the first, second or neither absolute-width cell
has noWrap. Body/all scope controls the merged footer. Two, three and four
automatic cells, unequal C0/C00/C000 labels and 6000/6001-twip table preferences
cross the protection states. No corpus assets or font binaries are included.

The reference application logical Cell.Width values were captured after Repaginate without saving
via `tools/record_mixed_width_rounding.ps1`. The reference hash-binds the DOCX
and case manifest. Logical widths are independent observations, not PDF paint
bounds or a complete visual certification. Relevant ECMA-376 Part 1 clauses:
17.4.29 (noWrap), 17.4.48 (tblGrid), 17.4.63 (tblW), 17.4.71 (tcW) and 17.18.87
(layout algorithm guidance). The observed distribution is measured reference
behavior; the guidance permits alternative algorithms, so no normative conflict
is asserted.
